Roblox Name: TheRealFoltyn

Insta: https://www.instagram.com/realfoltyn/

Twitter: https://twitter.com/Foltynnn

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

#Roblox #foltyn

snippet.title: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul | Official Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
A new manager. A departing striker. A changing team. Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul tells the story of how Liverpool turned their turbulent 2004/05 season, into glory on Europe's grandest stage.

Featuring compelling archive and interviews from Steven Gerrard, Jamie Carragher, Rafael Benítez, Xabi Alonso and many more, this is the definitive story of a win against all odds. Arriving to Netflix on May 19.

Watch on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/title/81752435

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul | Official Trailer | Netflix
https://www.youtube.com/@Netflix

At half-time in the 2005 Champions League final, Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history — as players recall in this documentary.

snippet.description:
Anthrax
It's For The Kids

https://orcd.co/itsforthekids
https://orcd.co/cursumperficio

snippet.title: SHAHRAH - Ebi & Shahin Najafi
snippet.description:
In the middle of the city, in the heart of the night
One by one, we faded in hand to hand fights
At the final dinner, where the table was stained with blood
Tell my mother she shouldn’t wait for me anymore

Let my voice be the balm on the wounds of these streets
If I’m gone, pass my place to the next in line
Lay my medals at the feet of these fearless souls
Tell them what courage these children of the 2000s had

We know that hopelessness is a mistake
We stay on this path, because it’s the main road
We sing this anthem with one united voice
Together, we will build the Iran of tomorrow

The silence of the night was shattered with you
The anthem of life was written with you
Blessed are we who live long enough
To sacrifice our lives just like you

Breath by breath, our chests are filling up
In the end, the cage will finally break
Let mothers one day tell
The story of this battle in their tales

We know that hopelessness is a mistake
We stay on this path, because it’s the main road
We sing this anthem with one united voice
Together, we will build the Iran of tomorrow

snippet.title: Forza Horizon 6 Review
snippet.description:
Forza Horizon 6 reviewed by Luke Reilly on Xbox Series X. Also available on Xbox Series S and PC.

"Technically, Forza Horizon 6 has not skipped a beat, and it runs like a titan. Aesthetically, it’s the best-looking and best-sounding game Playground has produced to date, set in the most wonderfully realised map it’s ever crafted – full of dense, authentic details and stunning driving roads. It’s rewarding to explore, the campaign is well-paced with a great payoff, and I simply cannot stop playing. I’ll always concede Forza Horizon 3 may forever be my favourite open-world racer, because who doesn’t love driving around their own backyard, but make no mistake: Forza Horizon 6 is unequivocally the best. The new standard in open-world racing is here, and it’s a gundamn masterpiece."

#IGN #ForzaHorizon6 #RacingGames

snippet.title: FOREVER — | Emotional Uplifting | Female Vocal Trance | Lumi Elara
snippet.description:
Inspired by the emotional depth of Lumi Elara, “FOREVER” is a powerful uplifting trance journey about love that transcends time, distance, and loss.

Built around soaring female vocals, euphoric melodies, cinematic atmospheres, and emotional drops, the track captures the feeling of holding onto someone long after the moment is gone — when memories become part of you forever.

“FOREVER” moves between vulnerability and strength, blending delicate emotional breakdowns with explosive trance energy that lifts everything into the sky.
It’s the sound of late-night thoughts, endless horizons, and emotions too deep to fade away.
For the hearts that still remember.
For the souls that never truly let go.
For the moments that stay with you forever.

Close your eyes.
Feel the rush.
And disappear into FOREVER.

snippet.title: FLYING MONKEY (Official Music Video) | BLUE MEDUSA
snippet.description:
BLUE MEDUSA – FLYING MONKEY (Official Music Video)

You’ve been asking. Here’s the answer.
This is BLUE MEDUSA - Alissa White-Gluz's new band.
🎵 Stream & save everywhere: bluemedusa.com/flyingmonkey

Directed by: Vicente Cordero and Alissa White-Gluz

🔔 Subscribe to BLUE MEDUSA: https://youtube.com/@BlueMedusaMusic

---
Flying Monkey

by Blue Medusa

Gave up your pride,
Your dignity,
For a pair of taxidermic wings.
How convenient!
When the room went crooked, you blinked.

Your palms,
Blistered from, 
Clapping for a king that,
Erased your face.
Paper halo, hollow spine… borrowed time.

Suddenly flies come to blacken the skies,
As they drink up lies and they feed on decay.
The puppeteer’s strings tangle in their wings,
And they tumble to Earth under gluttonous weight.

Flying mOnkey!
(You are not welcome here)
Fly away!
This ain’t that kind of circus,
So get back!
I won’t be another victim to your rat pack,
Enjoy your plummet.
Flying mOnkey!

Words of glass, right on cue.
You may look different now, 
But gravity recognizes you,
And it is calling you down.

I don’t walk the ground where the carrion lies, 
I don’t trace the paths of the morally grey,
Gravity bets on devotion unchecked, 
I don’t fall with the things that are born to obey.

Patience. 
This rots inwards (in words).
No one survives a favour.
Wait your turn.

Honour the dust that made you.
As it welcomes you home.
I’m not the one that betrayed you.
You should have watched where you’d flown.
---

The birds, they fly
I see it all
They flee it all
We flock together
They move past
Lighthouse
Fly south through clouds
Can’t see the ground
Can hear the sound, but can’t get back down
Could this be my last

Break away from the roots
Before the storm comes for you
Raise me up from the noose
Carry me back on the wind to you

Crossroads
Don’t know which way is leading home
The water flows
Somehow the clearest way to go is not the path I chose
So will you?

Break away from the roots
Before the storm comes for you
Raise me up from the noose
Carry me back on the wind to you
Now we blind ourselves from the truth
Heaven on high, it’s in view
So break away from the roots
Carry me back on the wind to you

Bound to the tempest swirling ‘round
Embracing now, final breath
Rise from the confines
Life is found
Unbound, at the crest

Black skies, thunderous
Cross the rift
Lightning tears the sky

Break away from the roots
Before the storm comes for you
Raise me up from the noose
Carry me back on the wind to you
Now we blind ourselves from the truth
Heaven on high, it’s in view
So break away from the roots
Carry me back home on the wind to you
